queries.result: First-party results identified Senegal's DGID cadastral authority, its CSF Ziguinchor, and the official ONDDL SIG geospatial portal. No first-party public parcel polygon service was found in discovery.

registryEvidence.custodian: Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines (DGID), avec Centre des services fiscaux (CSF) Ziguinchor; local cadastral bureau evidence also appears in DGID material.
registryEvidence.basis: The official DGID site identifies the agency as responsible for land and cadastral policy and lists CSF Ziguinchor at Rue Struch, Ziguinchor. Official DGID-hosted material states that the Ziguinchor cadastral bureau updates cadastral sections and records parcels/NICADs. This is custodian/procedure evidence, not an open parcel download.

officialSources.observation: Official DGID landing page; identifies DGID's land/cadastral role, cadastral services, and lists CSF Ziguinchor.
officialSources.scope: National cadastral custodian with a named local service; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint exposed on the page.

officialSources.observation: Official ONDDL SIG GeoNode portal; current configuration points to its public GeoServer and catalog.
officialSources.scope: National geospatial portal; published catalog inspected during this attempt.

requests.outcome: Fetched official viewer shell and read embedded current GeoNode/MapStore configuration; public GeoServer base is https://sig.onddl.sn/geoserver/.
Fetched current viewer info/configuration; default CRS is EPSG:3857 and no parcel layer was configured in the landing-page catalog settings.
Anonymous catalog returned 9 published resources: administrative/GADM and Casamance layers only; no cadastral or parcel resource.
Current WFS schema advertised geonode:dep_pole_casamance, departement, region and GADM layers only; no parcel feature type.
Bounded anonymous response returned one non-parcel administrative point for ZIGUINCHOR with geometry CRS EPSG:4326 and fields fid/id/name/reg/dept/codes; no parcel polygon.
Likely parcel layer name was rejected as unknown feature type; this is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

remainingUncertainty: DGID/CSF Ziguinchor custody is evidenced, but public parcel geometry, stable parcel identity field mapping, citywide coverage, and adapter robustness remain unverified.
